name: Admiral
description: UK bittering variety released in 1998.

name: Ahtanum
description: Citrusy hop used for flavoring and aroma, higher grape fruit character than cascade and less bitterness. Some pine notes. Name comes from the area in Washington where it was first grown.

name: Amarillo
description: Aromatic citrus hop with medium bittering potential. Great for dry hopping and late additions.

name: Apollo
description: Strong bittering hop, with citrus, resiny and spicy components. Super Alpha category for use in the most bitter of beers.

name: Ariana
description: Ariana hops are a new variety just released by the Hop Research Center in Hüll, Germany. Ariana is the daughter of Herkules and a wild male and is a high-yielding variety. It is juicy with dark fruits like blackcurrants and is backed by smooth oak, tobacco, and vanilla. There are also some bright elements of grapefruit when used in late additions.

name: Azacca
description: Named for the Haitian god of agriculture, Azacca™ boasts an intense tropical fruit profile.

name: Belma
description: A very clean hop, with a very orange, slight grapefruit, tropical pineapple, strawberry, and melon aroma.

name: CTZ
description: ‘CTZ’ (short for the Columbus, Tomahawk, and Zeus varieties of hops) is a dual puprose hop with complex flavors and an earthy, citrus-y and spicy aroma. Great for bittering, as well as American pale ales and IPAs.

name: Citra
description: Citra, as the name implies, has a strong citrusy profile. This is largely credited to its very high myrcene content. It has an extraordinary flavor profile of grapefruit, lime and tropical fruits but despite its high alphas, brewers often warn against its use for bittering, which is considered by some to be harsh and undesirable.

name: Columbia
description: A Centenial substitute. Very pungent, aromatic, and clean tasting. ambers, ales, pale ales, porters and stouts. Related to Willamette

name: Dr. Rudi
description: A dual purpose / bittering hop with classic resinous pine and lifted citrus characters

name: Ekuanot
description: Developed by Hop Breeding Company and released in 2014, Ekuanot™ Brand HBC 366 features pronounced aroma characteristics and extremely high oil content. This variety bursts out of the spring soil in vibrant yellow and gradually matures to a deep green color by fall harvest.

name: El Dorado
description: Dual purpose hop. Bright tropical fruit flavors and aromas of pear, watermelon, and stone fruit.

name: Ella
description: Reminiscent of, yet distinctly different from, noble European varieties - one of the most versatile hops available.

name: Falconer's Flight
description: Proprietary blend of hops.

name: Galaxy
description: Galaxy is a popular Australian variety of hop, frequently used as a late addition for its aromatics and fresh flavor. Great for pale IPAs and pale ales.

name: Green Bullet
description: Developed in New Zealand, Green Bullets have a lemony aroma and a grassy, spicy flavor. Great for ales and lagers.

name: Hallertau Blanc
description: Next-generation German hops for 21st century craft beer: highly aromatic, tropical, floral, and fruity.

name: Hallertau Tradition (Germany)
description: Earthy, grassy, aromas of nectar fruits. Tradition is a Hüll-bred fine aroma hop originating from Hallertau Mittelfrüher, Hallertauer Gold and Saaz. Bred specifically for fungus and disease resistance, it succeeded in that effort and also features higher alpha acids than its parent varieties, low cohumulone and higher myrcene.

name: Horizon
description: Bittering hop with good flavor, released in 1998.

name: Huell Melon
description: Bred at the Hop Research Institute in Hüll, this hop variety has bold flavors and is not necessarily associated with typical hop variety aromas.

name: Kohatu
description: A dual purpose hop with fresh tropical fruit characters and excellent finish and bitterness

name: Lemondrop
description: The bright citrus and subtle herbaceous notes are perfect for sessionable beers. While ales tend to bring out her sweeter side, Lemondrop is delicate and refined enough for quality lagers.

name: Loral
description: Developed by Hop Breeding Company and released in 2016, Loral™ Brand HBC 291 has a noble heritage that straddles the fence between old and new world hop aromatics. It has the ability to complement all beer styles, making it a very versatile hop in the brewery. Loral™ has been described as pleasant with floral, citrus, peppery and some dark fruit characteristics.

name: Magnum
description: A potent and clean bittering hop designed in German laboratories from Hallertau and other German strains.

name: Mandarina Bavaria
description: Bred at the Hop Research Institute in Hüll, Mandarina Bavaria displays pleasant fruitiness in finished beers.

name: Monroe
description: The new hop variety Monroe established itself similarly extravagant as who it was named after. With an alpha content of only 2.5 % and an oil content of 0.95 ml/100 g, Monroe showcases itself at the beginning as mild and smooth. When you add the hop to a beer, then she shows her true colors: exactly like everyone remembers Marilyn Monroe in a red dress. A guise full of red aromas. In the nose, there are wonderful raspberry notes supplimented with orange syrup and added to this in the taste is the sweet taste that reminds one of summer and cherries.

name: Mount Hood
description: Derived from Hallertau, this hops has a higher yield for growers. Good for lagers. Clean, slightly spicy flavor.

name: Mount Rainier
description: Newer Oregon variety with noble characteristics, licorice accent.

name: Moutere
description: A high alpha hop with distinctive tropical, grapefruit and passion fruit characters

name: Opal
description: Developed at the Hüll Research Center, Opal exhibits excellent aroma characteristics combined with a respectable alpha acid level.

name: Pacifica
description: Similar to its Hallertau parent, Pacifica hops have an orange citrus and floral aroma. Great as a bittering addition for a solid finish.

name: Pilgrim
description: A dual purpose hop variety, Pilgrim hops have a hoppy aroma and an earthy, spicy flavor. Great for English ales.

name: Rakau
description: A New Zealand triploid, purpose-bred and selected for its unique dual purpose brewing qualities and characteristics, Rakau has yielded great results over several brewhouse applications through sensory panels that have scored uniformly high on the quality of bitterness as well as unique fruity flavours and aromas. It was once described as “The whole orchard." It is often used in New World styles of ales and lagers where brash fruity character and big but well constructed bitterness is desired. It is great when used in combination of very late additions and dry hopping.

name: Riwaka
description: A unique aroma hop with a powerfully fueled tropical ?assion fruit ?character

name: Saphir
description: A German hop variety with low alpha acid, Saphir hops have a bright character, floral flavor and citrus aroma. Great for German lagers and Belgian ales.

name: Simcoe
description: Multi-purpose hop with high bittering potential and aromatic qualities.

name: Sonnet
description: A new variety of hop developed from a variation of Saaz, Sonnet has floral notes and low alpha acid content. Great for English ales.

name: Southern Cross
description: A dual purpose / soft bittering hop with a citrus ?emon zest?character with hints of pine

name: Sovereign
description: A dwarf aroma hop variety, Sovereign has a fruity, grassy and floral aroma and flavor. Great for English and American Ales.

name: Spalter Select (Germany)
description: The result of a cross of Spalt and Hallertau Mittelfrüher, Spalter Select retains some of the finer characteristics of both these varieties and is considered a slightly spicier version of Spalt.
substitutes: Saaz, Tettnanger, Spalt, Hersbrucker, Perle, Hallertau Tradition

name: Summer
description: Bred in 1997 at Tasmanian Bushy Park Breeding Garden, Summer™ is the result of open pollination of a tetraploid Czech Saaz. It features balanced citrus and stone fruit flavors, but showcases distinct apricot and melon characteristics in dry hopping applications.

name: Summit
description: Strong citrus grape fruit aroma profile and flavor. Dwarf variety, started in 2003.

name: Taiheke
description: New Zealand grown dual purpose US Cultivar with citrus ?rapefruit/lime?characters

name: Vic Secret
description: Pineapple, pine, passionfruit. The flavors are lighter than the ones you will find in Galaxy hops.

name: Wai-iti
description: A fine aroma hop with fresh peaches and apricot characters within a weight of essential oils

name: Waimea
description: A big alpha hop that carries an even bigger weight of oils with lots of pine and citrus characters

name: Wakatu
description: A really fine dual purpose hop with a heady mix of floral and citrus characteristics

name: Wye Challenger
description: New Zealand grown dual purpose hop with balanced bittering. Spicy, clean citrusy aroma with distinct herbal notes.

name: Zamba
description: Zamba™ formerly known as Samba hop blend boasts remarkably juicy tropical fruits (pineapple, mango), stone fruits, candy, and orange tangerine. The Zamba™ Hop Blend has a complex aroma characterized by juicy pineapple and mango with bursts of stone fruits, and tangerine. Brewing Application Zamba™ is perfect for late kettle and dry hop additions for big juicy and hazy IPAs, or any other hop-forward ale or lager. Early brewing trials showed the fruity character exhibited in sensory carried through into the finished product.

name: Zappa
description: Usage: Aroma, whirlpool, and dry hopping for any hop- or complementary fruit-forward style: hazy or milkshake IPA, fruited sour, pale ale, American strong ale, and wild or mixed-fermentation beers. Aroma & Flavor Characteristics: Spicy with strong notes of tropical fruit (mango, passion fruit), citrus, and pine. Additional descriptors include savory, mint, and Fruity Pebbles™.

name: Zythos
description: Hop blend designed for IPAs
